result.text:
# Warehouse replenishment

Original CC0 verification note, authored for this local acceptance check. The reorder point equals expected demand during supplier lead time plus safety stock. For daily demand of 12 cartons, lead time of 5 days and safety stock of 15 cartons, reorder when inventory reaches 75 cartons.
